Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000190": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000185": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000526" [decision]: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000633": As of 2025-09-04, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift, having picked it up from Farah.  (about: Tomasz, Farah, team Dune)
- memory_id "1000454": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000495" [decision]: As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000128": The reporting service is owned by team Dune.  (about: team Dune, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000502": As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then.  (about: Boreal team, team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000650": On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000368" [decision]: Marcus took over the Boreal team on-call shift from Lena on 2025-05-07.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000145": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000087": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000261" [decision]: Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000542": The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
Existing entity names: the bus, webhook dispatcher, notifier, Boreal team, Atlas team, billing API, Tomasz, Farah, team Dune, Lena, Oskar, job scheduler, Cinder team, reporting service, ledger service, Ember team, authentication gateway, Marcus, Priya Raman
